record.note: Scoped design review for the #5111 source change: one-module local-dev staging reuses actual receipt4/metadata/WASM validation, requires current preserved source evidence and unchanged shared recipe, retains frozen historical release bytes and never promotes candidate to release or changes CI checks. Separately versioned release metadata still requires real release build evidence and existing activation authority. This reviews the contract only, not runtime, host, release or playtest acceptance. Reviewed the concrete storage 0.2.0 local sync/check command: exact originally captured execution image, no automatic image rebuild, explicit one-module IDs and distinct versioned hash/identity paths. Default release checks remain historical and candidate receipt4 freshness remains separate; this is method documentation, not proof of production activation. 本次增量复核确认：fetcher、外部 compiler 与默认构建均应独占仓库 .tmp 内的工作目录；原子创建区分名称碰撞与实际 IO 失败，清理只作用于本次取得的目录。该约束保持 Docker 挂载、字节 hash 校验和外围发布授权边界，产品要求无需调整。本记录只确认系统合同，不代签构建、运行或发布验收。
